coverage: All twenty-six scenes in both original-en and modern-en: named cast, speaking roles, contextual unnamed relatives, and named mythical, religious and song references.

entities.name: King Lear
entities.body: The aging king of Britain and father of Goneril, Regan and Cordelia; the play’s central character.

snapshots.body: The aging king and father of Goneril, Regan and Cordelia.

entities.name: The Earl of Kent
entities.body: A nobleman in Lear’s service.

snapshots.body: Lear’s loyal nobleman, banished for defending Cordelia.
The banished earl serving Lear in disguise.
The Earl of Kent, who served Lear in disguise as Caius.

entities.name: The Earl of Gloucester
entities.body: A nobleman at Lear’s court, father of Edgar and Edmund.

snapshots.body: Edgar and Edmund’s father, now blinded.

entities.name: Edmund
entities.body: Gloucester’s younger son, born outside marriage, and Edgar’s half-brother.

snapshots.body: Gloucester’s younger son, now given his father’s earldom by Cornwall.

entities.body: Gloucester’s elder son and heir, Edmund’s half-brother.

Gloucester’s elder son, now dressed as a peasant after his disguise as Poor Tom.
Gloucester’s elder son, who has revealed himself after fighting Edmund.
